description: Find all actors born after 1970 and return their name and birth year ordered by birth year ascending, limit 10.

expected_queries.cypher:
MATCH (p:Person)
WHERE p.born > $p0
RETURN p.name AS actor_name, p.born AS birth_year
ORDER BY p.born ASC
LIMIT $p1
expected_queries.sql_pgq:
SELECT
  gt.actor_name,
  gt.birth_year
FROM GRAPH_TABLE (
  movie_graph
  MATCH (p:Person WHERE p.born > :p0)
  COLUMNS (
    p.name AS actor_name,
    p.born AS birth_year
  )
) AS gt
ORDER BY gt.birth_year ASC
LIMIT :p1
expected_queries.iso_gql:
MATCH (p:Person WHERE p.born > $p0)
RETURN p.name AS actor_name, p.born AS birth_year
ORDER BY p.born ASC
LIMIT $p1
expected_queries.duck_pgq:
SELECT
  gt.actor_name,
  gt.birth_year
FROM GRAPH_TABLE (
  movie_graph
  MATCH (p:Person WHERE p.born > $1)
  COLUMNS (
    p.name AS actor_name,
    p.born AS birth_year
  )
) AS gt
ORDER BY gt.birth_year ASC
LIMIT $2
